column1: # The BASKET ruler: what a cross-section of real single names looks like, at three levels, for the
# `-basket` channel (N equity names as observational second-pass instances of the primary).  The
# rows the model is graded against are the eight semiconductor names of folio's binary-trend-01
# under the SMH sensor -- NVDA AMD AVGO TSM ASML MU KLAC LRCX -- over 2012-01-04..2026-08-31 (3685
# sessions), daily Yahoo adjusted closes, LOG returns.  `BasketAnchorSuite` / `basket_anchor_tests`
# re-derive the graded bands from the `eight` rows; editing a row moves the shipped bands.
# Conventions.  vol = sd of daily log returns x sqrt(252), %.  gaps10 / gaps5 = sessions with
# |r| > 10% / 5% per year.  maxDD = deepest peak-to-trough decline, %.  d10 / d20 = share of sessions
# more than 10% / 20% below the running peak.  acf1 = lag-1 autocorrelation of |r|.  kurt = daily
# kurtosis.  The basket is the EQUAL-WEIGHT mean of the members' simple returns, as a log series.
# pairCorr = the 28 pairwise correlations of daily log returns.  idioShare = 1 - R^2 of a name on
# SMH.  tailCoincidence = on the basket's worst-1% sessions, the share of names below their own 1%
# cut.  The mechanism rows split sessions by SPY's return decile.  Eras: 2012-2019 and 2020-2026.
# LEVEL 1 grades a name against a population of names, not an index: the eight run 1.9-3.4x SPY's
# volatility (16.6%) and gap an order of magnitude more often (SPY: 0.1 sessions/yr past 10%).
# LEVEL 2 is the basket's relation to its group index (SMH) and to the market -- SPY for the S&P
# anchor set, QQQ for the Nasdaq set: in the model, which has no sector index, the basket's
# aggregate IS the sector, and the `corrSpy`/`betaOnSpy`/`volRatioSpy` rows (or their `Qqq`
# counterparts) are the relation it is graded on, per anchor set; level 1's vol ratio reads
# against the set's primary vol (`SPY vol` / `QQQ vol`).  LEVEL 3 is what a basket rule reads.  The `population` rows are the
# cache's 26 single names with data from 2012 (AAPL AMAT AMD ASML AVGO AXTI CAMT CAT CIEN CLS COHR
# FN GLW GOOGL INTC JBL KLAC LRCX MRVL MSFT MU NVDA PLAB TSEM TSM VWDRY): SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED --
# folio's book, selected today -- so context, never a band.
# The "aggregate clusters more than its members" check is NOT clean in the record (by era the basket
# sits inside the members' range), so the acf1 rows are readings, not a gate.
# Measured 2026-09-02 (scratchpad basket_anchor.py; the model-side statistics are the twins' own).
